description: Mantra Lv5 single-cast FULL HIT theoretical data. Values are community wiki estimates; candidate list NOT exhaustive. All segments summed assuming same target hit. No target resist, no proc damage.

mantras.name: Ceaseless Slashes
mantras.warning: CONFLICTING SOURCE: Deepwoken Builder reports 290 Lv5 base after 2025 nerfs; 310.05 Fandom tick breakdown is unverified on current patch. Additional slashes possible with ether/timing.
mantras.caveat: Wiki detailed 20-hit sum 310.05 conflicts with builder Lv5 base 290; do not call this verified maximum.

mantras.name: Ceaseless Slashes (Deepwoken Builder Lv5)

segments.label: builder Lv5 aggregate base (tick breakdown not exposed)

mantras.warning: Represents the 290 aggregate Lv5 base shown by Deepwoken Builder; actual multi-hit tick count is 20+ in-game, not 1.

mantras.name: Tornado
mantras.warning: Builder aggregate 186.48 vs older 12×14.8=177.6; difference equals +5% and might reflect After Cut already. Do NOT add another After Cut without verifying the server. Older per-tick data is retained rather than implicitly overwriting per-tick counts.
mantras.caveat: Builder 186.48 matches 177.6x1.05 (15.54/tick or After Cut baked in), not independently confirmed in Fandom Version History.

mantras.name: Shadow Meteor

mantras.warning: Builder L5 shows 32, interpreted as per meteor from 3-meteor skill description. Three impacts on same player not guaranteed. May-2026 Shadow Meteor nerf corroborated.
mantras.caveat: Exact post-nerf Lv5 damage value not exposed numerically on Builder or Fandom patch table.

mantras.name: Ether Barrage
mantras.status: L5 base 48 = 6 × 8, Builder + Fandom cross-check; 6 hits only if full cast connects
mantras.warning: Wiki describes FOUR orbs but SIX damage instances total; do not multiply 4 × 6 × 8. 0.65s windup, 10s cooldown, 0 posture, close-range auto-track. Crystal/Perfect Lens improves autotrack range. It is not a single-impact skill, and 6 ticks on one player require testing.
